item.title: Greek Australian Women Shine at Inaugural Diaspora Forum

item.title: Greek Police Raid Santorini IPTV Operation: One Reseller Arrested, 68 End Users Face Prosecution
item.description: Greek police raided an illegal IPTV operation on Santorini, arresting a 48-year-old reseller and referring 68 customers for prosecution under new anti-piracy laws that now criminalize even end-user consumption of pirated streams.
